name: Scary monke horror
summary:
Step into the paws of a gorilla and crawl through dark, twisting air ducts in search of scrap and forgotten garbage. The deeper you go, the more you will find and the more dangerous it becomes.

Hunt with your friends or go it alone as you scavenge, burn, and upgrade your gear. Customize your gorilla with cosmetics, improve your tools, and watch your stash grow.

Every run is tense, every corner holds something unexpected, and every decision matters. Work together, compete for resources, or just cause chaos
